response.sql: WITH mt_stats AS (SELECT mt.Name AS media_type, AVG(t.Bytes * 1.0 / t.Milliseconds) AS byte_rate, COUNT(*) AS track_count FROM Track t JOIN MediaType mt ON mt.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY mt.Name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(byte_rate) AS overall_rate FROM mt_stats), above AS (SELECT s.byte_rate, s.track_count, s.byte_rate - o.overall_rate AS excess FROM mt_stats s CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE s.byte_rate > o.overall_rate) SELECT AVG(byte_rate) AS avg_byte_rate, AVG(track_count) AS avg_track_count, AVG(excess) AS avg_excess_rate FROM above;

assumptions.assumption: Track count per media type includes all linked tracks, including those with NULL Bytes; only the byte-rate average skips tracks with no size.

Byte rate uses Bytes * 1.0 / Milliseconds so the division is not truncated to an integer (SQLite-style integer division otherwise applies). Tracks with Milliseconds = 0 yield NULL and are ignored by AVG.
Media types are grouped by MediaType.Name, so distinct MediaTypeIds sharing a name are merged into one group, and a NULL name forms its own group.

alternatives.interpretation: Track count per media type counts only tracks that have a size (Bytes not NULL), consistent with excluding sizeless tracks from the whole calculation.
alternatives.sql: WITH mt_stats AS (SELECT mt.Name AS media_type, AVG(t.Bytes * 1.0 / t.Milliseconds) AS byte_rate, COUNT(t.Bytes) AS track_count FROM Track t JOIN MediaType mt ON mt.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY mt.Name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(byte_rate) AS overall_rate FROM mt_stats), above AS (SELECT s.byte_rate, s.track_count, s.byte_rate - o.overall_rate AS excess FROM mt_stats s CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE s.byte_rate > o.overall_rate) SELECT AVG(byte_rate) AS avg_byte_rate, AVG(track_count) AS avg_track_count, AVG(excess) AS avg_excess_rate FROM above;
